name: code-architecture-analyzer
description: Deep Python architecture analysis with automatic refactoring — analyses a single file OR a whole package/directory with cross-file detection (Shotgun Surgery via repeated magic literals). 51 criteria (SOLID, anti-patterns, LLM-aware, Django-Aware, Security, FeatureEnvy, ShotgunSurgery, LSP, UselessListComp), Intent Learning (learns from your feedback), Agent Review (metacognitive prompts for AI agents with 20 design patterns), --agent mode for AI coding agents, accuracy harness (recall/precision corpus, per-file + cross-file), i18n pt/en, HTML dashboard auto-generated, ruff-powered (no pylint), criteria cache. Pre-commit gate. 348 tests.
author: Sergio MT
